requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Rough-cut lengths from the meadow's oaks. It is the first thing you gather and the last thing you stop needing — walls, tools and campfires all start here.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Rough-cut lengths from the meadow's oaks. It is the first thing you gather and the last thing you stop needing — walls, tools and campfires all start here.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Close-grained wood cut from the old-growth stands on the Rise's flank, so dense a fresh-cut round barely floats. It is still wood — the axe is still the tool — but it takes twice the swinging, and what it braces does not give.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Close-grained wood cut from the old-growth stands on the Rise's flank, so dense a fresh-cut round barely floats. It is still wood — the axe is still the tool — but it takes twice the swinging, and what it braces does not give.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Bitter resin boiled out of ironwood bark and cut with berry pulp. More than twice a small potion's worth in one go — the thing you carry into a gauntlet where there is no time to stop and pour three.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Bitter resin boiled out of ironwood bark and cut with berry pulp. More than twice a small potion's worth in one go — the thing you carry into a gauntlet where there is no time to stop and pour three.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A heavy bronze disc struck with Team Tether's mark and the ploughed-furrow device of the high pasture posting. A captain carries one, and hands it over when they lose — the officers' own rule, and they keep it.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A heavy bronze disc struck with Team Tether's mark and the ploughed-furrow device of the high pasture posting. A captain carries one, and hands it over when they lose — the officers' own rule, and they keep it.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A rigid frame built to take real weight, its joints braced with worked rootstone rather than plain wood. Not a saddle yet — just the part that has to be right before the rest of one is worth building.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A rigid frame built to take real weight, its joints braced with worked rootstone rather than plain wood. Not a saddle yet — just the part that has to be right before the rest of one is worth building.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A plain, unmarked sphere from Grandpa's old pack — no dial, no fittings, nothing fancy. It works because your throw does the work, not the orb.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A plain, unmarked sphere from Grandpa's old pack — no dial, no fittings, nothing fancy. It works because your throw does the work, not the orb.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A small dose that restores 50 HP to one creature. It only works on a creature — for you, it's soup and rest, same as always.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A small dose that restores 50 HP to one creature. It only works on a creature — for you, it's soup and rest, same as always.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A denser, costlier draught than a potion, and the only thing that raises a creature back up once it's fainted. It comes back at half its full strength — a proper rest is still what finishes the job.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A denser, costlier draught than a potion, and the only thing that raises a creature back up once it's fainted. It comes back at half its full strength — a proper rest is still what finishes the job.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Wrapped and a little sticky, found rather than bought. Feed it to a creature and that creature is one level further along, no fight required — the addendum's exploration-reward candy, three tiers of the same wrapper.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Wrapped and a little sticky, found rather than bought. Feed it to a creature and that creature is one level further along, no fight required — the addendum's exploration-reward candy, three tiers of the same wrapper.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: The blue-wrapped tier — a tougher detour or a stronger encounter earned it. Two levels on the creature that eats it, no fight required.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: The blue-wrapped tier — a tougher detour or a stronger encounter earned it. Two levels on the creature that eats it, no fight required.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Blue-capped, found clustered at tree bases and rocks. The same timed-buff mechanism a tonic already uses — the world reward version of one.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Blue-capped, found clustered at tree bases and rocks. The same timed-buff mechanism a tonic already uses — the world reward version of one.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Red-capped, broad and unmistakable. A short attack buff — the least specialised of the three, general-purpose foraging.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Red-capped, broad and unmistakable. A short attack buff — the least specialised of the three, general-purpose foraging.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: Short, sharp, and built for stripping — one clean pull takes fiber off meadow grass that bare hands would only tear at unevenly.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: Short, sharp, and built for stripping — one clean pull takes fiber off meadow grass that bare hands would only tear at unevenly.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A broad flat blade on a long shaft, for turning matted meadow sod into soil loose enough to take seed. It is no use on a tree, a rock or a creature — the only thing it is for is the ground in front of a farmhouse.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A broad flat blade on a long shaft, for turning matted meadow sod into soil loose enough to take seed. It is no use on a tree, a rock or a creature — the only thing it is for is the ground in front of a farmhouse.

requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.main_utf8_value: A flat grey disc that hums faintly when a ground-type creature is near. Hold it out and the creature takes the shape of the move straight off it — once. The disc goes dull afterwards.
requested_fifteen_description_restoratio.cut_utf8_value: A flat grey disc that hums faintly when a ground-type creature is near. Hold it out and the creature takes the shape of the move straight off it — once. The disc goes dull afterwards.
